scope: Independent uniform rational points, log B=o(log p), log B/log log p tends to infinity, and the hypotheses in the note on inverter success and restart. The inversion algorithm remains open.
statement: At fixed genus g, m=(g+o(1)) log p/log B is the leading coverage threshold for sums from B sampled rational points. A p^o(1)-time inverter with p^(-o(1)) success on the specified typical-base distribution would yield a p^o(1)-time prime-subgroup discrete-logarithm algorithm.
